scenarios.name: Reveal earlier tabs without changing the active document

scenario_steps.name: the user opens `Window01.opd` through `Window12.opd` from `fixtures/cad/document-tabs-native/overflow` in order
the tab strip overflows its available width
a presentation is active while earlier tabs are out of view
the user clicks the left navigation arrow at the end of the tab strip
earlier tabs, including Home, become visible
the presentation remains active in the workspace
